channel.title: mint - companies
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: From warehouses to last-mile delivery: How India’s logistics companies are handling festive e-commerce rush
item.description: As festive online shopping gathers pace, India’s logistics companies are expanding warehouse capacity, hiring workers and using AI to manage deliveries. Rising order volumes, bulkier parcels and demand from smaller towns are testing their ability to keep shipments moving and meet delivery promises.

item.title: Binance hack: Crypto exchange resumes withdrawals after more than $6 billion stolen, sees outflow of $4.7 billion
item.description: Binance resumed customer withdrawals after a $6.3 billion cyber theft, reporting a $3.64 billion net outflow on Sunday. The exchange says it will cover the losses and has replenished 90% of the stolen funds. The FBI has attributed the attack to the North Korean hacking group TraderTraitor.

item.title: Flipkart looks to expand FPO tie-ups with focus on value-added, premium produce
item.description: The e-commerce company is investing in local sourcing, demand planning and premium offerings to reduce wastage and strengthen its quick-commerce supply chain.

item.title: Japanese investors deepen India bets, creating a bigger business opportunity for law firms
item.description: Sifting sands of geopolitics has meant that India and Japan come closer. Last year, Japan pledged a target of JPY 10 trillion in private and public investments into India over the next decade. Since Aug 2025, 120 MoUs have been signed targeting over ₹1 trillion of cross border investments

item.title: Air India weighs Singapore Airlines executive for CFO as losses mount
item.description: Air India's management has held preliminary discussions on the appointment with Tata Sons chairman N. Chandrasekaran and Air India chief executive officer (CEO) Tewolde Gebremariam, both of whom are understood to be supportive of the move.

item.title: TSMC’s $265 Billion Campus Is Driving a Real Estate Boom in the Phoenix Suburbs
item.description: The world’s biggest chipmaker is pulling in suppliers, home builders and Taiwanese investors who have seen firsthand how the company can change a local economy.

item.title: PNB union seeks audit of 10,500 branches after ₹11.24 cr fraud, multiple suspensions; warns against ‘knee-jerk’ action
item.description: The Punjab National Bank's union has urged the management to audit all 10,500 branches and examine staffing, training, security and management oversight after alleged fraud at its Greater Noida branch. Details here.&nbsp;

item.title: DivyaSree Developers, HDFC Capital partner to set up ₹1,500 crore residential platform
item.description: The partnership aims to build a ₹6,750 crore development pipeline over the next three to four years as the commercial property developer accelerates its residential expansion across major Indian cities.

item.title: Why did Amazon cut 250 jobs in its devices unit despite new product launches? What employees were told
item.description: Amazon has cut up to 250 jobs in its devices and services division, mainly affecting software development roles. The company cited efficiency and changes to its product plans, while employees were informed through early morning texts and emails.

item.title: Apax co-CEO bets on India’s AI strengths, eyes faster investment
item.description: Apax Partners has invested about $4 billion in India and returned more than $10 billion to investors. Despite currency pressures and market uncertainty, the private equity firm sees long-term opportunities and may direct around 10% of its next fund to Indian businesses.

item.title: Amul launches high-protein cubes: How to buy online – 25 g protein at just ₹80; 150 calories, 38 gm pack in 5 flavours
item.description: Amul has launched high-protein cubes, a savoury snack offering 25g of protein and 150 calories per 38g pack. Check details of the new product here.&nbsp;

item.title: Who is Deepali Masirkar of ONGC? IPS, London School of Economics alumna, now Executive Director-Chief Security
item.description: Masirkar is a 2008-batch IPS officer of the Nagaland cadre. She holds a Bachelor of Science degree from St Francis College, affiliated with Osmania University in Hyderabad, and an LLB degree from Mumbai University.

item.title: Maruti flags mounting shipping disruptions in West Asia, but exports resilient
item.description: The challenges come even as Maruti Suzuki’s exports jumped 59.3% in October, suggesting room for further growth once the conflict eases.

item.title: Binance resumes bitcoin, ether withdrawals after recovering 95% of $6.3 billion in crypto theft; check details
item.description: Binance resumed withdrawals for 15 cryptocurrencies in phase 1 after using its own funds to cover about 95% of the $6.3 billion stolen in a heist. Details here.

item.title: Listed hotel chains, developers line up nearly 10,000 room signings in October
item.description: Lemon Tree, IHCL and Brigade led expansion signings this month as operators are targeting tier 3, 4 cities, airport hubs and emerging leisure markets

item.title: Jio says tariff hikes can wait, eyes 10-15 partners for overseas play
item.description: Jio Platforms plans to drive growth through digital services and overseas technology partnerships rather than rely solely on mobile tariff hikes.

item.title: Bank of Baroda plans overseas expansion, targets wholesale banking in developed markets
item.description: India's second-largest public sector lender is weighing retail banking in emerging economies as it builds on strong international growth; it also expects margins to improve in the December quarter.

item.title: Who is Xavier Niel? French billionaire to acquire 16.2% stake in Vodafone in a ₹54,103 cr deal | All you need to know
item.description: French billionaire Xavier Niel has secured CCI approval to acquire a 16.2% stake in Vodafone. The Iliad founder built his fortune through low-cost telecom services before expanding into media, startups, and artificial intelligence. Here’s a look at his career and investments.

item.title: Tech Mahindra prioritises growth blitz after margin boom
item.description: As he completes 12 quarters at the helm next month, Tech Mahindra CEO Mohit Joshi talks about prioritizing organic growth, decoupling headcount from revenue in the AI era, and eyeing larger acquisitions next year.

item.title: DeepSeek Drops Enhanced Coding Agent With Aim to Rival Anthropic
item.description: DeepSeek has released a prototype of a more autonomous coding agent as it seeks to challenge Anthropic PBC’s popular Claude Code.

item.title: Warren Buffett hasn’t had water in 50 years; billionaire investor Bill Ackman reveals | Watch video
item.description: Bill Ackman recalled that Warren Buffett declined water at a dinner, choosing Cherry Coke instead and claiming he had not had water in 48 years. Buffett is known for drinking five cans of Coke daily and has often joked about his devotion to the beverage.

item.title: Who is Alice Huang? US accuses ex-Megaspeed exec linked to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang of spying for China: What we know
item.description: Former Megaspeed top executive Alice Huang’s links to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang have come under scrutiny amid reports of suspected intelligence sharing with Beijing. Singapore has denied investigating her alleged intelligence ties.

item.title: French billionaire Xavier Niel gets CCI nod for 16.2% Vodafone stake: What is the €5.1 billion deal?
item.description: The CCI has approved French billionaire Xavier Niel's €5.1 billion deal to acquire a 16.2% stake in Vodafone Group through his investment vehicle Vega SAS. The acquisition, from Emirates Telecommunications Group, will make Vega Vodafone's largest shareholder.

item.title: LANXESS and BPCL partner to advance specialty lubricant solutions in India
item.description: The partnership leverages LANXESS' global lubricant additive expertise, formulation capabilities, and existing OEM relationships alongside BPCL's strong domestic market presence, base oil portfolio, manufacturing infrastructure, and extensive customer reach

item.title: The Morning Show star Reese Witherspoon takes back control of Hello Sunshine, but why is firm cutting 50% of workforce?
item.description: Reese Witherspoon's production company Hello Sunshine has reportedly laid off around 30 employees, or half its workforce, weeks after she and Mediawan reacquired it. The company is moving away from direct-to-consumer ventures to focus on films, TV and books.

item.title: Doctors back their own software: Docterz raises ₹5 cr, nearly 60% from users of its clinic platform
item.description: Docterz aims to deepen its presence in the Indian clinic software market while adding AI capabilities that reduce administrative load. For a company founded by a practising doctor and now backed substantially by its own users, the funding reinforces a model built on practical utility.

item.title: Supreme Infrastructure moves closer to settling ₹2,200 crore debt after NCLT extends payment deadline
item.description: NCLT Mumbai extends deadline to October 31; SBI, PNB and Union Bank agree on framework for completing settlement obligations

item.title: How a Michelin-recognised chef built chole bhature business in Dubai; he sells it for ₹500 as people queue for hours
item.description: Pradeep Khullar was 15 years old when his father passed away after battling cancer in 1998. Most of the family's savings had gone towards his father's treatment, leaving them in financial difficulty.

item.title: Ophthalmic products recalled: Why drug regulators ordered Sun Pharma to halt eye-drop production at Assam plant?
item.description: Drug regulators flag failures in quality management system; Sun Pharmaceutical’s compliance report under review

item.title: Infosys Hyderabad Pocharam campus: New 1.1 million sq ft block adds 10,000 seats, supports 13,000 employees
item.description: Infosys has opened a 1.1 million sq ft development block at its Hyderabad Pocharam campus, adding 10,000 seats and capacity for more than 13,000 employees under a hybrid model. The expansion supports growing demand for AI, cloud, cybersecurity, engineering and other technology services.

item.title: Pharma company Gufic buys Lodha Avalon duplex in Juhu for ₹236 crore
item.description: The purchase adds to a growing list of high-value deals at Lodha Developers’ luxury Mumbai project, which has attracted pharmaceutical promoters and business executives.

item.title: Lab Rats series: Activating ‘natural killers’ for cancer with Zumutor
item.description: Zumutor Biologics is betting on a novel cancer drug that activates natural killer cells. With its lead candidate in phase 1 trials, the startup faces the challenge of turning early clinical signals into a licensing deal and investor returns.

item.title: Greater Noida PNB Fraud Case: CBI names Deepanshi, Ashutosh Pathak - What are they accused of? Details
item.description: The CBI has registered a case on alleged fund diversion at PNB’s Greater Noida branch. With ₹10.24 crore in unauthorised debits identified and employees suspended, the bank is examining customer accounts and settling claims. Here is what the complaint says and what investigators have found so far.

item.title: Virat Kohli takes big leap in Agilitas Sports stakes after One8 merger; what it means for both companies? Full details
item.description: Virat Kohli's ownership in Agilitas Sports, a home-grown sportswear firm, has increased to 6.4 per cent from 1.8 per cent, following the merger of cricketer's firm One8 Sports.

item.title: After Welcomhotel Manesar, ITC Hotels expands Delhi-NCR presence with 105-key Fortune Select Greater Noida
item.description: ITC Hotels has signed a management agreement for the 105-key Fortune Select Greater Noida, expanding the brand’s presence in Uttar Pradesh and the NCR. Located at India Expo Plaza, the hotel will cater to corporate, MICE and leisure guests and is expected to open early next year.
